diagnostic.historicalFailure: Optional display-field echo could disagree with the canonical part binding and terminate an otherwise identity-resolved preview.

answers.A_resolveEntity: The formal part identity is the canonical packaging part above; no fuzzy first-result selection is used.
answers.B_mismatch: The failure family was optional model/supplier echo, not partId, quantity, or packing-role ambiguity.
answers.C_safeDetails: PACKING_IDENTITY_MISMATCH now returns a sanitized canonicalBinding containing only partId, model, supplier and packingRole.
answers.D_recoverability: The agent can safely retry from formal canonical binding evidence; it does not need to guess a catalog record.
answers.E_searchParts: No: a verified canonical partId is sufficient for the API to recover formal display attributes.
answers.F_echoRequirement: The API no longer requires model/supplier echo. When supplied, each remains strict-validated against the canonical part record.

contract.canonicalization: Business API canonicalizes display fields from the formal part ID before scenario cost calculation.
